what: A synthesizer with 26 engines and 819 level-matched factory sounds: three-oscillator HYBRID, six-operator FM, wavetables, early-1980s polysynths, a semi-modular two-filter voice, physical models and more. One instrument with a modulation matrix, arpeggiator and step sequencer, edited in the browser.
author: Eberon Limited (John Gorman)

smk37.what: The same 26 engines and 819 sounds on the SMK-37 Pro, played from its 37 keys with pad and key aftertouch, the wheels and a pedal. The installer takes the SMK-37 Pro only and never writes the keyboard's factory calibration.
